evidence.name: Screen field: Plan card arrangement
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Plan card arrangement" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Plan card arrangement
sections.description: Choose how the plan cards are laid out. Vertical stacks them one under another, which reads best on mobile and works well for 2 to 4 plans; Horizontal lines them up side by side as compact cards, good for 2 short price options you want compared at a glance. Start with Vertical unless you specifically need a side-by-side comparison.
